countries.portal: Ministry of Interior — Visa Services (Visa Inquiry & Printing)
countries.tip: Work visas issued by an employer can be checked and printed on the MOI portal before travel.

countries.portal: Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Unified Visa Platform
countries.tip: Use the official MOFA visa platform to check visa issuance and print the visa.

countries.portal: ICP Smart Services (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security)
countries.app: UAEICP app; Dubai visas: GDRFA Dubai (gdrfad.gov.ae)
countries.tip: Dubai-issued visas can also be checked on the GDRFA Dubai website.

countries.portal: Ministry of Interior — e-Services
countries.tip: Ask your sponsor for the visa number — Kuwait work visas are issued to the employer.

countries.portal: Royal Oman Police — eVisa
countries.tip: Employer-sponsored and e-visas are tracked on the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal.

countries.portal: Kingdom of Bahrain eVisa
countries.tip: Use the eVisa portal's status check with the reference number you received.

countries.portal: Immigration Department of Malaysia
countries.tip: Foreign-worker permits are applied for by the employer — confirm the status with the employer and the Immigration Department.

countries.portal: Ministry of Manpower — check work pass status
countries.tip: Work Permit and S Pass applications are tracked on MOM; visit visas on ICA.

countries.portal: Korea Visa Portal
countries.tip: Use 'Check application status' on the Korea Visa Portal.

countries.portal: Japan eVISA (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
countries.tip: eVISA applications show their status in your online account.

countries.portal: Republic of Türkiye e-Visa
countries.tip: Only use evisa.gov.tr — many look-alike sites charge extra fees.

countries.portal: Romanian eVisa portal (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
countries.app: Work permits: General Inspectorate for Immigration (igi.mai.gov.ro)
countries.tip: The employer gets the work permit (aviz de muncă) from IGI first; the long-stay visa is then tracked on the eVisa portal.

countries.portal: Welcome to Serbia — Government portal for the single work & residence permit
countries.app: Type D visa: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mfa.gov.rs); e-Government: euprava.gov.rs
countries.tip: Since 2024 the employer files a single work-and-residence permit online; its status is visible on the official portal.

countries.portal: Republic of Moldova e-Visa (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
countries.app: Work & residence permits: General Inspectorate for Migration (igm.gov.md)
countries.tip: Work permits are approved by the General Inspectorate for Migration; the visa itself is tracked on the e-Visa portal.

countries.portal: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade
countries.app: Work permits: Employment Service Agency (av.gov.mk); residence: Ministry of Interior (mvr.gov.mk)
countries.tip: There is no public online visa tracker: ask the embassy or consulate where you applied, quoting your receipt number. Work permits are issued to the employer by the Employment Service Agency.

countries.portal: VFS Global — Track your application
countries.app: Some countries use TLScontact or BLS instead
need: Last name or date of birth
countries.tip: Tracking shows where your passport is; the visa decision is made by the embassy.

countries.portal: GOV.UK — UK Visas and Immigration
countries.app: UK Immigration: ID Check app / UKVI account
countries.tip: Your eVisa and status are shown in your UKVI account.

countries.portal: CEAC — Visa Status Check (U.S. Department of State)
countries.tip: Statuses: Issued, Refused (221g), Administrative Processing.

countries.portal: IRCC — Check your application status
countries.tip: Use the IRCC application status tracker inside your secure account.

countries.portal: ImmiAccount / VEVO (Department of Home Affairs)
countries.tip: VEVO shows the conditions of a granted visa.

countries.portal: Ministry of the Interior (MUP) — residence and work permits
countries.app: Type D / Schengen visa: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs (mvep.gov.hr)
countries.tip: For work, the employer applies for the combined stay-and-work permit at the police administration; ask your employer for the application number before you pay any agent.

countries.portal: e-Konsulat — Polish consular visa system
countries.app: Work permits: praca.gov.pl (filed by the employer at the Voivodeship Office)
countries.tip: A Polish work visa needs a work permit (zezwolenie na pracę) issued to your employer first; check that permit with the employer and the Voivodeship Office, not with an agent.

countries.portal: Enter Hungary — National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing
countries.tip: Residence-permit-for-work applications and their status are handled online in Enter Hungary; you see the status after signing in.

countries.portal: Ministry of the Interior — information for foreigners (status of application)
countries.app: Employee Card: the job must be listed in the Labour Office's central register first
countries.tip: Czech long-term visas and Employee Cards are decided by the Ministry of the Interior; use the proceeding number from your embassy receipt.

countries.portal: MIGRIS — Migration Department information system
countries.tip: National D visas and temporary residence permits for work are applied for and tracked in MIGRIS.

countries.portal: Portal das Comunidades / Vistos — Ministry of Foreign Affairs
countries.tip: Portugal's visa site lists the documents per visa type; the residence permit after arrival is handled by AIMA.

countries.portal: Il Visto per l'Italia — Ministry of Foreign Affairs
countries.app: Work: nulla osta issued to the employer by the Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione
countries.tip: An Italian work visa starts with a nulla osta under the yearly decreto flussi quota; a job offer without a nulla osta is not a work visa.

countries.portal: e-Albania — Government e-services (e-Visa)
countries.tip: Albanian visas and the unique work-and-residence permit are applied for through e-Albania.

countries.portal: Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal) — Federal Foreign Office
countries.app: Some missions still use VFS Global appointments
countries.tip: National (D) visas, including skilled-worker visas, are increasingly applied for and tracked in the Auslandsportal.

countries.portal: Irish Immigration Service — visa decisions
countries.app: Work: employment permit from the Department of Enterprise (enterprise.gov.ie)
countries.tip: Ireland publishes weekly visa decision lists by application number on the immigration site.

countries.portal: Immigration New Zealand
countries.tip: Approved visas are issued electronically; check the eVisa in your Immigration Online account.

countries.portal: Indian Visa Online — Government of India
countries.app: Bangladesh applicants: Indian Visa Application Center (ivacbd.com)
countries.tip: From Bangladesh, the passport is submitted at IVAC; use the web file number on your receipt to follow the application.

countries.portal: Thailand e-Visa — Ministry of Foreign Affairs
countries.tip: Thai e-Visa status and the approval PDF are shown in the account used to apply.

countries.portal: Vietnam e-Visa — Immigration Department
countries.tip: Only evisa.gov.vn is official; many look-alike sites charge extra fees.

countries.portal: Sri Lanka ETA — Department of Immigration and Emigration
countries.tip: Check the ETA status on eta.gov.lk before you fly.

countries.portal: Indonesia e-Visa — Directorate General of Immigration
countries.tip: Use only evisa.imigrasi.go.id; the e-Visa PDF can be verified there.
